title: CPSC, Brinkmann Announce Recall of Outdoor Tabletop Propane Heaters
summary: The heaters can emit high levels of carbon monoxide (CO), which poses a risk of CO poisoning to consumers. Units: About 45,000.

title: CPSC and Graco Announce Recall of Toy Track on Activity Centers
summary: The toy track can break, presenting a cut or pinch hazard, and exposed small parts pose a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 152,000.

title: CPSC, Little Tikes Announce Recall of Pop 'n Scoot Ride-on Toys
summary: Young children who lean forward can fall forward over the handlebars, causing facial injuries. Units: About 21,400.

title: CPSC, Specialty Sales Co. Inc. Announce Recall of Novelty Cigarette Lighters
summary: These lighters do not have child-resistant mechanisms, as required by federal law. Young children could ignite the lighters, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 6,000.

title: CPSC, Brookdale International Systems Inc. Announce Recall of Emergency Escape Smoke Hoods
summary: The smoke hood is a one-time emergency use personal safety device, that provides quick temporary protection from smoke in the event of a fire. In some instances, consumers purchased the smoke hoods for protection from tear gas or chemical warfare agents, but the smoke hoods should be used only to pr

title: CPSC, Island Soap & Candle Works Announce Recall of Candles
summary: Pieces of the candles' wick can fall off while burning and the wick can re-ignite after extinguishing, posing a burn and fire hazard. Units: About 29,000.

title: CPSC, Megatech Announce Recall of Rechargeable Battery Packs for Radio Controlled Airplanes
summary: The internal battery cell connections may slip and result in arcing and overheating, posing a fire or thermal burn hazard. Units: About 3,000.

title: CPSC, Luxo Corp. Announce Recall of Portable Fluorescent Lamps
summary: The ballast (the electrical part located in the arm of the lamp) in these lamps can overheat, short-circuit, and melt the insulating cover of the ballast, causing the lamp to fail and posing a skin burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 18,300.

title: CPSC, In-Sink-Erator Announce Recall to Repair Instant Hot Water Dispensers
summary: Water can leak from the metal holding tank, wet insulating material and cause electrical arcing and heat build-up. This poses a fire hazard. Units: About 252,200.

title: CPSC, Candle-lite Announce Recall of Martha Stewart Everyday™ Brand Potpourri Simmering Pots Sold at Kmart
summary: Flames from the tea light candles inside these potpourri pots can flare out of the side ventilation holes, possibly causing burns to consumers. Units: About 80,000.

title: CPSC, Hammacher Schlemmer & Co. Announce Recall of Lighters
summary: The lighters were imported into this country without first being tested to ensure they comply with the Consumer Product Safety Commission's requirements that the lighters be child-resistant. Child-resistant requirements were adopted to reduce the risk of fires and deaths caused by children playing w

title: CPSC, Mountain Safety Research Announce Recall of Stove Fuel
summary: Corrosion can cause the can to leak fuel, posing a fire or injury hazard. Units: About 9,700.

title: CPSC, BY US International Co. Announce Recall of "NEXT" Ultra Shock Bicycles Sold at Wal-Mart
summary: The forks on these bicycles can break apart, causing riders to lose control, fall and suffer serious injury. Units: About 132,000.

title: CPSC, UL United Inc. Announce Recall of Electrical Paintings
summary: The electrical paintings can short circuit, posing a shock or fire hazard. Units: About 150.

title: CPSC, Radio Flyer Inc. Announce Recall to Repair Ride-On Push Cars
summary: A child can pull the horn off the car's steering wheel, and a small part inside poses a choking hazard. Units: About 15,000.
